blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Erwin Tulfo urged overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in France, Saudi Arabia and Israel to take extra precautions amid reports of chaotic incidents such as violent unrest, attacks and security threats in the three countries. Tulfo, vice chair of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, warned Filipinos in France, particularly those in Paris, to remain vigilant amid violent confrontations between protesters and authorities, as well as reports of looting. Clashes between police and demonstrators, widespread looting and several fires erupted across France on Saturday as nationwide protests over rising inflation escalated into violent confrontations.
